name: Raffileur
source:
Ishtoria is a kingdom where blessed roses bloom. The main character, who hates the royal family for some reason, hides herself in a monastery and lives modestly.

The year she turns 20, she was invited by a man she was interested in to a national festival, which she had avoided up going to until that point. News of the second prince's return overlapped with the festival.

However, it was all a trap set to lure her to the royal palace. 

The prince she hated calls the main character a 'savior' and offers her a game of chance: either she becomes his queen, or if she doesn't come to like him, he will take his own life the night before the coronation ceremony.

There are only 10 days left until the fateful coronation. Will the 'savior' who is trapped in the royal palace adorned with blessed roses bring salvation or ruin? 

[Translated & edited from [url=https://usurahi.net/raffileur/]official website[/url]]
translation:
伊什托利亚是一座盛开着祝福蔷薇的王国。因某种缘由而憎恨王室的主人公，隐居在修道院中过着低调简朴的生活。

满20岁那年，她受心仪男子的邀请，前去参加自己此前一直避而不去的王国庆典。而第二王子归来的消息，也恰好与这场庆典重合。

然而，这一切全是为了将她引诱进王宫而设下的圈套。

她所憎恨的王子称主人公为“救世主”，并向她提出了一场赌局：要么成为他的王后；倘若她最终无法爱上他，他便会在加冕仪式前夜自尽。

距离宿命的加冕仪式仅剩10天。被困在装点着祝福蔷薇的王宫之中的“救世主”，带来的究竟会是救赎还是毁灭？

[编译自[url=https://usurahi.net/raffileur/]官方网站[/url]]
